title: Understand the purpose of the field
description: What semantic purpose does this field serve? What makes a value correct?

title: Evaluate the current value
description: Does the current value satisfy the purpose? Stop here if yes.

title: If current value satisfies field, stop
description: Do not search for alternatives if the current value is already valid.

title: If uncertain, use research strategies
description: Use available techniques to gather evidence when current value is questionable.

title: Compare discovered candidates
description: Weigh evidence for each candidate URL against the field purpose.

title: Choose the best candidate
description: Select the URL that best satisfies the field purpose.

title: Explain your reasoning
description: Provide clear justification for your choice.
